# Null-aware

var x = a ?? b;
var y = a?.b;
var z = a?[b];
var w = a!;

==>

Program(Declaration(VariableDeclaration("var",Identifier,"=",BinaryExpression(Identifier,"??",Identifier),";")),Declaration(VariableDeclaration("var",Identifier,"=",MemberExpression(Identifier,"?.",Identifier),";")),Declaration(VariableDeclaration("var",Identifier,"=",IndexExpression(Identifier,QuestionBracket,Identifier,"]"),";")),Declaration(VariableDeclaration("var",Identifier,"=",UnaryExpression(Identifier,"!"),";")))

# Type Test

var b = a is int;
var c = a is! int;
var d = a as int;

==>

Program(Declaration(VariableDeclaration("var",Identifier,"=",TypeExpression(Identifier,"is",Type(TypeNoQuestion(TypeIdentifier(Identifier)))),";")),Declaration(VariableDeclaration("var",Identifier,"=",TypeExpression(Identifier,"is","!",Type(TypeNoQuestion(TypeIdentifier(Identifier)))),";")),Declaration(VariableDeclaration("var",Identifier,"=",TypeExpression(Identifier,"as",Type(TypeNoQuestion(TypeIdentifier(Identifier)))),";")))
